args.title: Maintenance Window Schedule
args.description:
This ticket is to schedule the upcoming maintenance window. Please follow these steps:
1. Choose a date and time that minimizes impact on users.
2. Notify all relevant teams at least 7 days in advance.
3. Document the changes being made during the maintenance.
4. Ensure there are backup plans in place for critical systems.
